act: Deeper · III · How the lobbying works
head: Lobbyists named for network clients gave their own money to committees tied to 303 serving members.
deck: The first bar requires the giver’s firm to have been registered for a network client when they gave. The second also requires a filing for that client to name the giver.
note: These personal gifts can count as third-party records in the opening chamber. The filings leave any effect on a vote open.
